desc: Assess test quality: behaviour vs implementation testing, mock usage
context: Sample 10-15 test files from app/tests/**. For each: (1) assess whether tests verify behaviour/outcomes or test internal implementation details; (2) check that external services (LLMs, databases, HTTP calls) are mocked; (3) check for inappropriate use of @pytest.mark.skip without explanation; (4) identify tests that are likely flaky (time-dependent, order-dependent, or relying on real external services).
acceptance_criteria: External services confirmed mocked or flagged if not
Skipped tests with missing explanations listed
